# RE_T-PHE — Trustworthy Premarital Health Education (T-PHE)

> Public research record for a conference abstract (TIMA/FIMA Scientific Convention 2026) proposing Trustworthy Premarital Health Education as primary prevention infrastructure for intimate-partner harm. Practitioner-led conceptual synthesis; programme theory; no effectiveness testing. Field: public health, preventive medicine, health promotion, safeguarding. Language: medical science only.

Claim ceiling: the accepted abstract. Nothing in this repository claims that T-PHE improves, prevents or reduces any outcome. The originating organisation is a social enterprise in Thailand; the corresponding author founded it and this conflict of interest is disclosed.

## Start
- [AI readers — start here](AI_START_HERE.md): what this is, reading order, how to verify, what not to conclude
- [README](README.md): overview, layout, how to reproduce the integrity check

## Document of record
- [Abstract, verbatim web copy](abstract/ABSTRACT.md): the accepted abstract; PDF in the same folder is the document of record, SHA-256 pinned
- [Evidence ledger](CLAIMS.md): every disputable statement graded by evidence type
- [Journal-format version](paper/journal/main_journal.pdf): the same programme theory in tier-one medical-journal format (≤4,300 words, 56 references, structured abstract, key messages, glossary); supplementary material in paper/journal/supplementary.pdf; not peer reviewed
- [Systematic evidence map](paper/evidence-map/sr_main.pdf): scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) of the evidence library; all counts script-derived from library/; not a systematic review of effectiveness
- [Full paper, preprint draft v0.4](paper/main.pdf): the abstract expanded to a programme-theory paper (IMRAD, evidence review, safeguarding specification, invitation to co-design); not peer reviewed; LaTeX source in paper/

## Evidence library
- [Evidence library index](library/README.md): verified PubMed and global-guidance records by category (see the index for the current count); each entry shows the verifier's verdict and corrections
- [Unified JSON](library/library.json): every admitted entry in one schema
- [Knowledge graph](library/kg/graph.json): records, categories, propositions P1–P7, safeguards, outcome domains and their relations

## Governance and review trail
